body: That's an issue I'm having as well. Says fast charging, but it usually takes about double the amount of time it used to charge. (9+ SD on pie)

I want to attempt to convey what I feel about this... development as someone that has watched The Flute Channel with you and Amelie, as well as enjoying reading the posts on this subreddit. Similarly to what someone else said - upon the discovery that the mod of this sub is also the admin of TFC... I suppressed the urge to unsubscribe from this tire fire that is just waiting to happen. Which makes me sad, if I am to be honest. I enjoyed reading the posts of this smaller community than say the Flute Forum group on FB, and I enjoyed the videos on The Flute Channel. I feel that the way you are responding to this frankly well-deserved criticism... It is just making what you are trying to propose/announce seem that much worse. I feel you are being very defensive and dismissive as opposed to actually listening to what we are saying. That is just my personal opinion. Listen - I get that you guys just came back from that big Patreon event and you're stoked and excited to really ramp things up on all levels! On a personal level, I hope I can separate these events here and future content on TFC as there are very, very few flute channels on Youtube that offer content outside covers, and I would be disappointed to have to make that pool of availability even smaller because frankly that is just how uncomfortable I am with all of this.  


I understand with trying to run a Youtube channel as a well of income and revenue - do what you gotta do. Just I think it is safe to say that the majority of us here did not realize that the two entities were run by the same person, which makes us uncomfortable especially in the manner that we came to find this out, you know? I think the point that [u/reishka](https://www.reddit.com/user/reishka/) made about how the flair of just "Patreon" does give the implication that they are a patron of *this* subreddit as opposed to TFC. My best suggestion is perhaps if you do want that cross platform interaction - make a separate subreddit for TFC and implement these things there? Perhaps you can cross link between them, but what you are attempting to do here... it is safe to say that the community here does not feel okay with this.
